partner_results_applied.use: Supplies the sharp diffuse limiting benchmark 3sqrt(2); the new theorem proves an explicit quartic deficit below this benchmark for one shared macroscopic row.
The 4.063070616806037 central witness lies outside the one-heavy scope and identifies the several-heavy-row frontier.

new_results.statement: For J=diag(1,1,-1), ||v||<1, arbitrary cap-one X, and independent G~N(0,sigma^2(I-vv^T)), sigma^2>=1/12, if p=v1^2+v2^2 and q=v3^2 then p_Q(0)<=3sqrt(2)[1-57p^2/640-3pq/16-3q^2/80]<=3sqrt(2)[1-3||v||^4/80].

For the exact target-admissible finite frame with one heavy row v and three m-coordinate uniform residual banks, p_{Q_m}(0) converges to the Gaussian-residual central density. Hence fixed nonzero v eventually retains the quartic deficit below 3sqrt(2).

unresolved_implication: No bound is proved for several interacting macroscopic physical rows or for off-center density levels; the unrestricted universal density theorem and continuity remain open. The revision-10 proposed conditional 2/3-moment bridge is source-refuted and must not be used.
next_step: Switch mechanism to at least two interacting macroscopic rows plus a diffuse residual and include off-center levels; seek either a central/off-center witness above 3sqrt(2) or a dependence-preserving no-escape theorem.
